title: ChatGPT Integrates iCloud Mail and Calendar for All Users
summary:
OpenAI has released a set of tools that link its AI chatbot to Apple's communication and scheduling apps. The new plugins enable users to search for specific emails, summarize inboxes, and modify events through the chat interface.

The integration is now available for users on all subscription levels across the iOS, desktop, and web versions of the service. The update follows repeated requests from the chatbot's user base for deeper compatibility with the iCloud ecosystem.

selectedTweets.bestBit: Available on all ChatGPT plans on web, desktop, and iOS.
selectedTweets.text:
Much requested, and now yours to connect: iCloud Mail and Calendar plugins are available in ChatGPT.

Ask ChatGPT to find that email, catch up on your inbox, check what’s next, or update a calendar event. Phew.

Available on all ChatGPT plans on web, desktop, and iOS. https://t.co/g68OWoFVg8
